compute_reflection_TE_TM: compute the TE and TM reflection coefficients for a stack of thin film layers
optimize_arc_thicknesses: optimize thin film layer thicknesses to minimize reflection using differential evolution
run_AR_coating_example: run the antireflection coating optimization example with default refractive indices and thickness bounds
compute_reflection_batched: compute batches of reflection coefficients by providing arrays for refractive indices and wavelengths
review_compute_reflection: review the compute_reflection function that uses fmmax to calculate thin film reflection for TE and TM polarization
